name: JobsPipe: Check if Company Hiring for Role
description: Check if a company is currently hiring for a specific job title or department
notes: Replace YOUR_JOBSPIPE_API_KEY with your actual API key
Replace {{company_domain}} with a Clay column reference (e.g., /column1)
Replace {{job_title}} with the role to search (e.g., 'software engineer', 'sales development representative')
Returns 1-10 matching jobs; total_results shows all matches
Costs 1 credit per unique job returned this month
